[gold:OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY]
hero.subheading: [green:NCET] has established itself as one of Bengaluru's leading autonomous engineering institutions, with a mission to blend human values with academic professionalism. Since its inception in 2001 under the Nagarjuna Education Society, it has grown into a [gold:NAAC A+] accredited hub of AI-driven learning, research and innovation — [gold:16] programmes, [gold:350+] faculty and a global alumni network [gold:15,000] strong, built for industry-ready placements.

hero.heading:
[green:NAGARJUNA COLLEGE]
[gold:OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY]
hero.subheading: [green:NCET] has established itself as one of Bengaluru's leading autonomous engineering institutions, with a mission to blend human values with academic professionalism. Since its inception in 2001 under the Nagarjuna Education Society, it has grown into a [gold:NAAC A+] accredited hub of AI-driven learning, research and innovation — [gold:16] programmes, [gold:350+] faculty and a global alumni network [gold:15,000] strong, built for industry-ready placements.

entries.body: Renewal of the Autonomous status from 2022-23 to 2031-32 for **10 years**
Accredited by **NAAC under Cycle-II with A+ Grade**.
**NBA Accreditation** for BE - CSE & BE - ECE
**3 Star Rating** for IIC Activities by Ministry of Education during 2023-24

entries.label: Mission
entries.body: To fulfill the vision by imparting **total quality education** replete with the philosophy of blending **human values** and **academic professionalism.**

entries.label: Quality Policy
entries.body: Nagarjuna College of Engineering and Technology (NCET) shall be maintained, as an “Institution of Excellence”, in the domains of Engineering, Technology and Management studies through **continual improvement of system**, **processes and academic professionalism.**
